subject: Post-discovery: scheduling technical deep dive (ML/infra)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@novahealth.com>, Dr. Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@novahealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: scheduling technical deep dive (ML/infra)

Hi Aisha / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and helpful context on your model latency constraints and deployment governance. As discussed, the next step that makes sense is a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with our ML + infra team so we can:

- Walk through your production inference profile (seq lengths, QPS, burst patterns)
- Map those requirements to Redwood Dedicated / Private deployment options
- Discuss caching, KV cache priming, and quantization trade-offs for cost/latency
- Surface any compliance/networking constraints for VPC/on-prem installs

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue, Jun 15 — 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30 PT
- Wed, Jun 16 — 10:00–11:30 PT (preferred by our infra team)

Suggested attendees from NovaHealth: engineers who own the model infra + a product/PM (to confirm success criteria). From our side I’ll have Dylan (solutions eng) + Ethan (infrastructure) join; I’ve cc’d Camila for continuity.

I attached the short MRP / data access requirements doc (novahealth_mrp_req_v2.pdf) and a blank NDA signature stub for your legal team if helpful. Can you confirm which window works and who on your side will attend? Also let me know if you want any specific items added to the agenda.

If Jun 16 10:00 PT works, I’ll send a calendar invite + Zoom link and a 1–page pre-read.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0138

--
Attachments: novahealth_mrp_req_v2.pdf (doc stub)

Thanks for the clear recap. Jun 16 in the morning PT looks best on our side — Rajiv will definitely join. Rajiv also asked whether someone from our security/compliance team should be on the call; I can loop them in if you think that would be helpful for the networking/VPC discussion.

Preferred slot: Wed, Jun 16, 10:00–11:30 PT.

Attendees from NovaHealth so far: Aisha Khan (TPM), Dr. Rajiv Patel (Lead ML), plus potentially 1 infra engineer (TBD).

Can you send the pre-read and an invite for Jun 16 10:00 PT?

Best,

Agenda (90 min)
1) 10 min — Introductions & success criteria (NovaHealth)
2) 20 min — NovaHealth inference profile (Rajiv) + live Qs
3) 25 min — Redwood architecture mapping (batching, KV cache, quantization)
4) 20 min — Deployment options & networking considerations (VPC/on-prem)
5) 10–15 min — Open items & next steps / mutual action plan

Pre-reads: short MRP doc attached; I’ll publish a 1-pager summary to Google Drive and share the link ahead of the meeting. Also attaching a blank NDA signature stub in case legal needs it.

I’ll send a calendar invite + Zoom link once you confirm the attendee list. Related doc link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/novapre-read
